description: This PHP source file defines the MBPackage class which manages module packages in SuiteCRM, including loading modules, generating manifests, building and exporting packages, handling relationships, and managing module metadata.

classes.name: MBPackage
classes.description: Represents a module package in SuiteCRM, providing methods for loading, saving, packaging, and managing module metadata, relationships, and installation artifacts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new package instance by setting its name and loading existing manifest data.

methods.name: loadModules
methods.description: Loads modules from the package directory.

methods.name: loadModuleTitles
methods.description: Loads module titles for a specified language.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an MBModule object for a given module name.

methods.name: getModuleByFullName
methods.description: Returns a module object based on its full name including package key.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a specified module from the package.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Generates the package manifest array, considering version and export options.

methods.name: buildInstall
methods.description: Builds the install definitions array for the package, including language and relationship files.

methods.name: getPackageDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the package.

methods.name: getBuildDir
methods.description: Returns the build directory path for the package.

methods.name: getZipDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where ZIP archives are stored.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads package metadata from manifest.php and initializes modules.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the package manifest and related metadata.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a packaged ZIP archive of the module package, along with manifest and license files.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Generates a node structure representing the package and its modules.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates package properties from HTTP POST request data.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames the package directory to a new name.

methods.name: updateModulesMetaData
methods.description: Updates metadata and renames language files for all modules.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the package with a new name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the entire package directory.

methods.name: customBuildInstall
methods.description: Builds install definitions for exporting customizations.

methods.name: getLanguageManifestForModule
methods.description: Builds language-related install manifest entries for a module.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsManifestForModule
methods.description: Builds custom fields manifest data for a module.

methods.name: getCustomMetadataManifestForModule
methods.description: Builds metadata files manifest data for a module.

methods.name: getExtensionsManifestForPackage
methods.description: Recursively finds extension PHP files within the package for inclusion.

methods.name: getColumnsName
methods.description: Returns the column names of the 'fields_meta_data' table.

methods.name: exportCustom
methods.description: Creates a ZIP package of custom modules and related files.

methods.name: convertLangFilesToExtensions
methods.description: Converts language files into extension format.

methods.name: copyCustomDropdownValuesForModules
methods.description: Copies custom dropdown language values to the package.

methods.name: getCustomDropDownStringsForModules
methods.description: Retrieves dropdown options for specified modules.

methods.name: getCustomModules
methods.description: Lists customized modules within the 'custom/modules' directory.

methods.name: getExtensionsList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of extension files for a module.

methods.name: filterExportedRelationshipFile
methods.description: Determines if a relationship file should be exported based on module inclusion.

methods.name: getRelationshipsForModule
methods.description: Gets relationship definitions involving a module.

methods.name: exportProjectInstall
methods.description: Builds a manifest snippet for project export.

methods.name: exportProject
methods.description: Exports the entire package as a ZIP project including metadata and manifest.

methods.name: getCustomRelationshipsByModuleName
methods.description: Retrieves relationships associated with a module.

methods.name: getCustomRelationshipsMetaFilesByModuleName
methods.description: Retrieves relationship metadata files for a module.

methods.name: deleteBuild
methods.description: Removes the build directory.
